Purpose: Reusable visual system tokens shared by all Page and Component .cox files.

Color.BackgroundCanvas: soft white / misty blue glass canvas
Color.SurfaceGlass: translucent white surface with subtle blue-gray stroke
Color.SurfaceElevated: slightly brighter translucent card with soft shadow
Color.SuccessAccent: green for running, healthy, positive deltas
Color.WarningAccent: amber for stopped, paused, degraded states
Color.ErrorAccent: red for destructive or unavailable states

Spacing.PagePadding: generous desktop spacing, reduced mobile spacing

UsageRule: Reference tokens by name inside .cox files instead of restating full styles repeatedly.
